positive.prompt: Check how much subscription quota is left across Claude, Codex, and Kimi before I route this task
Which provider has the most usable runway right now, and is any of them about to hit its weekly limit
This run failed in a way that looks like a rate or quota wall, read the provider quota and pace

negative.prompt: Produce a truthful status report on what actually works right now in this project
Slice this approved design into milestones and sprints with a points capacity

evals.prompt: Before I hand this T3 migration to an engineer, tell me whether we have provider headroom for it.
evals.expected_output: Current quota read per provider scope with percent remaining, pace, runway and spend priority, each with its read time, plus a statement of which scopes can carry a T3 task to completion and which cannot
expectations: Reads live quota rather than assuming headroom
Compares runway against the size of the task, not just percent remaining
Reports any non-nominal provider state or its remedy instead of treating it as healthy
Leaves the routing decision to the EM rather than picking the provider itself
